items.name: Stunt Jumps
items.description: Fifty marked ramps to launch a vehicle from for a checklist reward in GTA V; press coverage expects stunt jumps to return in GTA 6.

sources.title: GTA 5 Stunt Jumps locations and where to find all ramps

items.name: Base Jumps
items.description: Parachute jumps onto a landing target in GTA V, some through checkpoints, and all of them needed for 100% completion. Base jumping is confirmed for GTA 6, so a similar set of jumps is expected.
